summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K reporting its second quarter and half-year 2026 financial results, an ordinary earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer. The filing details revenue, adjusted EBITDA, net profit, and cash position, along with commentary from the CEO on strategic progress, including completed divestitures of RapidFit and Eyewear businesses and an investment in Replasia. No transaction terms, prices, or special-situation mechanics are disclosed. The divestitures were previously announced and are mentioned only in passing, not as the primary event of this filing. This is a routine current report, not a special situation.
